name: Scoreboard
description: A huge two-colour scoreboard for football, basketball, volleyball, table tennis, hockey or any game, with clock, periods and fouls.
prompt: A full-screen scoreboard: tap a team's half to score, +2 and +3 for basketball, fouls, a game clock with periods, sets that close themselves in volleyball and table tennis, team names and colours, undo, swap sides, landscape layout and saved results.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Un marcador enorme a dos colores para fútbol, baloncesto, voleibol, tenis de mesa, hockey o cualquier juego, con reloj, periodos y faltas.
